column1: The football final was the most exciting match I have watched this year.
My laptop charger stopped working just two weeks after I bought it.
The college fest had amazing performances and great food stalls.
The bus driver was rude and refused to stop at my usual stop.
I loved the new science fiction novel my friend recommended.
The lab experiment failed three times and we wasted the whole afternoon.
The library staff were incredibly patient and helped me find every book.
The mobile app keeps logging me out and I lost my saved notes.
